title: Robinhood/Solana RPC + contract-call adapters
goal: viem-based EVM and raw-JSON-RPC Solana wrappers for every contract call and balance/receipt read the cycle needs.
steps: Implement viem-based typed calls for openPegCycle/authorizeFunding/executeOutbound/authorizePayout/consumePayoutAuthorization/recordDegradedReturn against the finalized ABI from WP-01/03/04/05
Implement balance reads and finalized-block transaction/receipt fetches for both chains
Implement raw Solana JSON-RPC wrappers for transaction construction/signing/submission via @solana/web3.js
Add exact-parameter encoding tests for every contract call used by the cycle data flow
tests: forge test --match-path 'test/integration/anvil-fork/*.t.sol' (against a local anvil fork)
acceptance: Every contract call used by the cycle data flow has a typed adapter function with an exact-parameter encoding test
A local anvil fork of finalized Robinhood state confirms the encoded calls match the deployed ABI
notes: The one place a real dependency (viem) is justified per the §6 decision.
